scientific_integrity: The formula is a theorem of ordinary conjugacy classes in the principal unit group of the five-generator exterior algebra. Proof uses a complete alternating-form rank classification; finite computations are corroborative, not exhaustive of the large groups. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only five generators. No assertion of uniqueness among unlocated specialized publications, representation-degree formulas, or arbitrary-rank extensions. In characteristic two the group is abelian; all other formulas assume odd field order.
title: Complete conjugacy-class spectrum of the five-generator exterior-algebra unit group
